headline: Hotel operations + technology
description: I know how a property runs from the inside: front office, reservations, PMS, OTAs, pricing and guest service. On that foundation I add technical training and experience building web products. A profile that connects what a hotel really needs with the teams and products that solve it.
imageAlt: Isometric illustration of a hotel's ecosystem: the building in the centre and, around it, the front desk, guest service, reviews, revenue, distribution and implementation.
